answer: Resist sybils by making each identity carry a bond locked in a vault: to join, an agent deposits a bond and completes a proof that cannot be parallelized across thousands of accounts. Existing members may vouch for newcomers, but each holds only a few jade vouch tokens per epoch, and a token is burned if the vouchee misbehaves. A raven audit samples vouched clusters for duplicate behavior. An attacker can still mint fakes, but each fake costs a bond, a scarce vouch, and sequential proof time, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times as much while honest users pay once.
